title: THE MARKET IS TALKING
author: FelixFelixFelix
facts: 20 hidden (two baskets of 10 ERC-20 markets), 4 inputs
derived each block from market correlations, not stored
engine.js + renderer.js on EthFS, served via scripty.sol
one deterministic oracular sentence per block
description: A recurrent neural network whose body is the market itself: two curated baskets of live ERC-20 markets act as the hidden layers of a deep echo-state network, with recurrent matrices rebuilt every block from the Pearson correlations of their transfer activity and a readout that projects the state onto a 299-word vocabulary through a five-layer deterministic grammar. No weights are stored — they are re-derived, bit-for-bit, from sealed chain history by the renderer, whose engine is gzip-compressed JavaScript on EthFS assembled by scripty.sol from this ERC-721 instrument. The instrument holds the append-only inputs and mood logs; stateAt() reconstructs the exact state in force at any past block, which is what makes every reading of the oracle reproducible mark for mark.

call.note: stateAt(25599744) — returns the pinned inputs + mood state from which the engine deterministically re-derives the network

preview.note: Pinned inputs and mood state. The onchain renderer re-derives the network and its sentence from these words client-side.
